title: Zuzu's Modpack
body:
This modpack was created with one purpose in mind. Creating a small little modpack focused on building and enjoying the vanilla experience, with a fair bit of addons. and such, we have a small list of mods inside here.

create, because the mod feels like it belongs to minecraft.

sophisticated backpacks, because you never have enough space in the inventory!

corpse mod, because... lets be honest, who likes losing all his items in lava.

farmer's delight with add-ons, because we love a bit of cooking!

all of macaw's mods, because let's be honest, decorating a house is hard in vanilla.

all of yung's structures, as a nice change from the everboring minecraft buildings.

naturalist, because we need the cute animals!

phasmovoice, because it's just better to talk in game directly.

and so much more.
